# No. IRDAI/SUR/MISC/ORD/64/04/2019 

# **ORDER** 

# April 25, 2019 

# Re: Appoir'ltment of Election Officer to conduct Full Council Elections of Indian Institute of Insurance Surveyors and Loss Assessors (IIISLA) 

Mr. V. Devanathan, Head-Technical & Projects, General Insurance Council, Mumbai is hereby nominated as the Election Officer for conducting full council elections of IIISLA for 12 vacancies in accordance with S.No. 49 (a) Articles of Association (AoA) of IIISLA. Mr. Devanathan is advised to conduct elections in a smooth, fair and transparent manner and in accordance with AoA of IIISLA and IIISLA Regulations and Procedure for Conduct of Elections to the Council (Election Regulations). IIISLA is hereby advised to extend all the necessary co-operation and financial assistance required for smooth conduct of the elections in accordance with AoA and IIISLA Regulations & Procedure for the conduct of elections to the Council (Election Regulations). 

This order supersedes the Order No. IRDA/SURMISC/ORD/02/2017 dated 03.01 .2017, issued earlier in this regard. 

This issues with the approval of the Competent Authority. 

(Sujay Banarji) Member
